title: ralffzuf 150 abo pack
description: Small swords, yellow crit and sweep hits, plus a fresh new design for the Totem and Golden Apple.
body: This is the Ralffzuf 150 subscriber pack. I have edited the stone, iron, diamond, and netherite swords, as well as the totem and golden apple. The critical hit and sweep particles are now yellow. I also edited a yellow and red fire.
